|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 20 September 2002). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' ([[Dark Forces (V) (Virtual Set 3)]]): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #3 sheet (PDF made 3 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 20 September 2002; first release date unknown). Full text: “Deploy on table. Once per turn, may lose 1 Force to cancel a just drawn weapon destiny targeting your Dark Jedi, causing a redraw. Once per game, you may exchange one card in opponent's Lost Pile with a card on their Colo Claw Fish.[Immune to Alter]”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 3: Revolution, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “Deploy on table. Once per turn, if opponent just drew weapon destiny targeting your Dark Jedi, may lose 1 Force to cancel and redraw that destiny. Once per game, may exchange a card in opponent’s Lost Pile with a card on their Colo Claw Fish. (Immune to Alter.)” '''What changed:''' added “if opponent just drew weapon destiny targeting your Dark Jedi,”; “a just drawn weapon destiny targeting your Dark Jedi, causing a redraw.” → “and redraw that destiny.”; removed “you”; “one” → “a”; “opponent's” → “opponent’s”; “Fish.[Immune” → “Fish. (Immune”; “Alter]” → “Alter.)”.
|sources=* [https://web.archive.org/web/20071024153955/http://www.swccgpc.com/Resources/VirtualCards3.pdf#page=3 VirtualCards3.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, Internet Archive 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006; page 3, slip 31. Slip image and game text from this sheet.
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Dark Forces]].
* Full-card remaster: [[Virtual Set 3: Revolution#Cards|Virtual Set 3: Revolution]] (fan reconstruction, 2026).
